description: Expander for ONE that gives eight MIDI channels their own pitch, gate and velocity jacks; it goes immediately to the right of ONE

params.text: Picks which of the sixteen MIDI channels that row follows, stepped to whole channel numbers

outputs.text: The current note on that row's MIDI channel, at a volt per octave with ONE's global pitch bend added
10V while that row's channel has a note held, and 0V otherwise
The velocity of that row's current note, 0 to 127 mapped onto 0 to 10V

notes: with no ONE immediately to the left, every output here stays at 0V.
each MIDI channel holds one note at a time, so a new note on that channel replaces the one before it; two rows may watch the same channel if a duplicate is wanted.
the arrangement the maker supports is ONE set to Multitrack or Matriceal with its MIDI input set to Omni, so that every channel these rows select reaches it.

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
